UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Global uniqueness registry mapping a lowercase 1-to-4 character username key to its owning user ID.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the username owner.

username.description: Display username chosen by the user (1 to 4 characters).

usernameKey.description: Lowercase canonical username key matching the document ID.

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Per-user account record linking the unique 1-to-4 character username and Google Drive database file ID.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

driveFileId.description: Optional Google Drive file ID of the user's SQLite database.

DiagnosticLog.title: DiagnosticLog
DiagnosticLog.description: Immutable crash or non-fatal error diagnostic report uploaded for an authenticated user's device.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the device owner.

isFatal.description: True if captured from an uncaught crash; false for caught non-fatal errors.

tag.description: Subsystem tag such as UNCAUGHT_CRASH, AUTH, DRIVE_SYNC, or MEDIA_SERVICE.

deviceInfo.description: Manufacturer, model, Android version, API level, and primary ABI.

firebaseConfigured.description: Whether FirebaseApp was initialized at the time of the error.

timestampMs.description: Device epoch time in milliseconds when the error occurred.

FavoriteTrack.title: FavoriteTrack
FavoriteTrack.description: A user's saved favorite music track (device local, imported, or online Iranian trend) persisted in Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the track owner.

favoriteId.description: Sanitized Firestore document ID matching the document key.

trackId.description: Original MusicTrack identifier from local library, imported URI, or trending source.

mediaUri.description: Playback content URI or MP3 stream URL.

importedTrack.description: Whether the track was imported via system file picker.

remixTrack.description: Whether the track is a remix.

instaTrend.description: Whether the track is an Instagram trend.

fullTrack.description: Whether the full audio track is available.

addedAtMs.description: Client epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the user favorited the track.

TrackReaction.title: TrackReaction
TrackReaction.description: A single authenticated user's emoji reaction on a track, keyed by the user's UID to prevent duplicates.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the reacting user.

trackKey.description: Sanitized Firestore track identifier matching the parent trackKey segment.

authorUsername.description: Username or display label of the reacting user.

TrackComment.title: TrackComment
TrackComment.description: An authenticated user's comment posted on a music track.

commentId.description: Unique identifier matching the comment document ID.

trackKey.description: Sanitized Firestore track identifier matching the parent trackKey segment.

trackTitle.description: Track title at comment creation time.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the comment author.

authorUsername.description: Username or display label of the comment author.

/usernames/{usernameKey}.description: Enforces global uniqueness of usernames (max 4 characters).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each user's registered username and Drive database reference.

/users/{userId}/diagnosticLogs/{logId}.description: Stores immutable crash and error diagnostic reports per user device.

/users/{userId}/favorites/{favoriteId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's persisted favorite music tracks.

/tracks/{trackKey}/reactions/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's reaction on a track.

/tracks/{trackKey}/comments/{commentId}.description: Stores user comments on a track.
